displayName: Chart of Accounts & Wallets (Accounting Context — Phase 1)
userOutcome: Users can create and manage financial accounts (wallets) built on the five accounting types
scopeSummary: Accounting context phase 1 (internal/accounting/domain/account/): Account aggregate root with AccountCategory, AccountSubtype, Currency value objects. IsWallet() domain method. Dual-scope via Scope shared kernel. CreateAccount + ArchiveAccount commands. PostgreSQL accounts table with CHECK constraints. System account seeding on UserRegistered event. Dual API: /accounts + /wallets. Personal→household sharing.
risks: Account type taxonomy must be extensible
System account seeding must match accounting conventions
Dual-scope CHECK constraints at DB level
Account aggregate boundary must be clean — JournalEntry references by ID only
readinessReason: Research provides complete schema, Go domain model, repository interfaces, and API design.
handoffSummary: Implement internal/accounting/domain/account: Account aggregate root with value objects. Commands, PostgreSQL repo with dual-scope. System account seeding via UserRegistered event. Dual API endpoints. Next.js wallet list + forms.
